jobs.occupation: Associate, Hero Support (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Associate, Hero Support

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for an Associate, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a vital part of the Hero Support team, you act as the first point of contact for all our heroes, serving as a trusted advisor on policies and procedures. You will provide support in answering key queries to ensure a best-in-class employee experience.
- Operations & Support: You will manage a wide variety of queries from employees through our ticket system (JIRA) and help maintain our internal People Portal knowledge base to enable self-service. You will execute common, transaction-based services, including employment contract creation, amendments, termination letters, and certificates.
- Data Integrity & Accuracy: You are responsible for maintaining accurate employee data in our HRIS (Workday) with a sharp focus on accuracy and quality, ensuring preparatory data is ready for payroll and other stakeholder teams.
- Autonomy & Collaboration: You will work independently on standard operational tasks while receiving guidance on more complex cases. You will collaborate closely with other People Operations teams (e.g., Talent Acquisition, People Business Partners) and stakeholders (e.g., Legal, Payroll) to deliver timely, high-quality responses.
- Operational Excellence: We pride ourselves on meeting turnaround times and maintaining data integrity. You will actively impact our current ways of working by participating in operational People projects, where you will suggest process improvements, help define documentation, and contribute to the evolution of our support ecosystem.

Qualifications

- You are a recent graduate or have at least 6 months of work experience in People Operations and/or HR.
- You have a proven ability to work independently, swiftly, and effectively prioritise work in a high-volume, process-driven environment.
- You possess a strong system orientation and are proficient with HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, PeopleSoft, SAP).
- You have hands-on experience working with CRM/ticketing systems (e.g., JIRA, ServiceNow, Salesforce) and are comfortable managing tasks within a queue.
- You are meticulous and quality-driven, with superior attention to detail - this is critical for managing accurate employee data and legal documentation.
- You have a structured, analytical mindset and are a true organisational talent, capable of translating complex policies into clear guidance for employees.
- You are characterised by discretion, initiative, and team spirit, and you are not afraid to take ownership of assigned tasks and projects.
- You are "Employees are our Customers" focused, delivering high-quality, empathetic support to all stakeholders.
- You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and a good understanding of German (B1+).

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading

delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Manager, Indirect Procurement – Engineering Services, Supplies & Equipment (EMEA) (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.
- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).
- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.
- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.
- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.
- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.
- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.
- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.
- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.
- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.
- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.

What You’ll Bring

- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.
- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience
- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred
- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).
- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.
- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.
- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).
- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.
- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.occupation: Senior Tax Expert (International Tax Planning and Investment) (m/f/d) at Allianz SE (Normungsexperte/-expertin)
jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Allianz's strong inclusive culture encourages people to speak their minds, get involved and question the status quo. One means to cultivate teams with different perspectives is a regular rotation of Allianz Executive employees across functions, Allianz entities and geographies. Therefore, the company expects from its employees a general openness and a high motivation to regularly change positions and collect experiences across Allianz Group.
Who will you join?

The Group Tax - International Tax Planning & Investments team plays a pivotal role in shaping Allianz's global tax strategy. We are responsible for:

- Ensuring robust tax governance across all international operations (insurance and asset management), including defining, implementing, and continuously enhancing global tax standards and frameworks across the Allianz Group
- Leading tax structuring and lifecycle oversight of investments - from acquisition through holding to exit - including compliance, reporting, and audit support
- Driving tax planning and value optimization initiatives, aligned with Group financial objectives and capital efficiency

How can you make an impact?

A. Leadership of Transactions and Investment Structure:

- Drive the tax structuring, coordination, and execution of acquisitions, divestments, restructurings in complex international environment, ensuring tax considerations are embedded at the core of strategic decision process and aligned with tax strategy and governance standards
- Take end-to-end ownership of tax workstreams in transactions, orchestrating collaboration with local tax functions, asset managers, and external advisors
- Shape and approve the design of new investment structures and platforms for alternative investments
- Act as a key contributor to Group approval processes, providing clear, decision-oriented tax recommendations to senior stakeholders and committees

B. (Investment) Tax Planning:

- Design, drive, and implement tax planning and restructuring initiatives to optimize effective tax rate (ETR)/cash. This includes current and deferred taxes as well as impact on global minimum taxation
- Proactively identify and execute value creation opportunities, including safeguarding and optimizing tax attributes and capital-efficient structuring
- Anticipate and respond to global tax developments, ensuring timely adaptation of investment strategies and structures to maintain competitiveness and compliance

C. Risk Management:

- Identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax risks in relation to complex international, cross-border matters and investment activities
Support tax audits, controversy management, ensuring consistent and robust representation of Group positions

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Degree in business administration, economics, taxation, or law
- Certified tax advisor
- 5+ years professional experience as tax advisor or inhouse tax manager
- Fluent in German and English (written and spoken)
- Knowledge in SAP R3 / S4 Hana and MS Office

Preferred Qualifications

- Expert knowledge in national and international taxes (as well as Global Minimum Taxation), ideally with specific focus on investment structures
- Strong analytical and project management skills
- Experience with AI solutions and automatization of tax processes
- Highly motivated team player taking ownership, driving initiatives end-to-end, and consistently delivering results with a strong sense of accountability
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solutions

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

To learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment Process

Apply before: 7 October- Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to withdraw the posting prior to the advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
In case of questions reach out to Ms. Cintia Malnis at cintia.malnis@allianz.de

jobs.description:

At Teleon Surgical, a leading, international player in cataract surgery, you will contribute to better vision for patients worldwide on a daily basis. In an organization where sustainability, technology and team spirit are central, we are looking for an analytically strong and connecting

Financial Controller (f/m/d)

Location: Berlin Tegel

Start: 01.11.2026

Your role
You oversight the accounting operation, prepare financial analyses and reports, advise management on strategic financial issues and help manage risks. You will report directly to Finance Director and work closely with 4 accountant colleagues from the financial departments in the Netherlands and Germany.

Your main tasks are:

- Setting up and maintaining the accounting organisation, procedures and systems, and taking ownership of the monthly, quarterly and annual accounting closing process.
- Preparation of (consolidated) monthly, quarterly and annual reports.
- Ensuring compliance with local Gaap standard as well as IFRS, tax laws and regulations, including tax filings.
- Monitoring financial processes, verifying financial data accuracy and optimizing internal controls.
- Verifying monthly payroll and identifying and mitigating financial risks in business processes.
- Supporting sales and subsidiary control, and supply chain/operations control, to monitor performance.
- Assisting with the annual budget, developing financial forecasts and monitoring budgetary performance.
- Supervising (international) audits and liaising with external auditors and tax advisory.

What do you take with you?

- Completed college or university education in Finance, Business Economics, Accountancy or

similar.

- At least 5 years of relevant work experience, preferably in a professional accounting firm or in finance within a manufacturing environment. 
- Experience with consolidated reports and financial statements.
- Good knowledge of Dutch (or German) GAAP and IFRS reporting standards.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and excellent communication skills.
- Creative, flexible and resilient, with a proactive, hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
- Fluent command of English and German. Dutch is a plus.
- Knowledge and experience with Microsoft NAV / Business Central and Qlik.
- Willingness to travel

What do we offer?

- A permanent position in a future-proof industry
- Flexible work hours and hybrid work models 
- 30 days of vacation
- Training and development opportunities tailored to your goals
- Attractive benefits (disability insurance, company pension plan, DeutschlandTicket or meal vouchers)
- An international, collaborative team with flat decision-making structures
- A pleasant work environment with open lines of communication, room for initiative, and a well-coordinated team

About Teleon Surgical

Teleon Surgical is an innovative player in medical technology, specializing in advanced intraocular lenses and accessories for eye surgery. With more than 30 years of experience, an in-house R&D division and high-tech production in Spankeren, we serve customers worldwide. Our international team of 180 professionals works from five locations: Spankeren (NL), Berlin (DE), Verona (IT) and Seoul (KR).

jobs.occupation: Director Solution Architect – Central Europe & Middle East (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - IT)
jobs.description:
Director Solution Architect – Central Europe & Middle East is a strategic pre-sales leadership role responsible for driving solution architecture, proposal strategy, and commercial structuring across our highest-impact opportunities. Spanning Central Europe and Middle East markets (with an immediate focus on Saudi Arabia), this role leads solutioning on complex deals while instituting deal governance, quality assurance, and AI-driven methodologies across the regional portfolio.

This role operates in a deliberate pre-sales capacity, distinct from Delivery leadership, ensuring solution integrity, margin protection, and high-win-rate architectures before handover.

Key Responsibilities

- **Deal Leadership & Solution Architecture:** Act as the lead solution architect on the region's largest, most complex opportunities, designing innovative, high-margin, and winning proposal strategies. 
- Portfolio Coaching & Practice Standards: Coach and support solution leads across the regional deal portfolio, driving adoption of the Solutioning Principles v1.0 framework and its core rituals.
- **Middle East Expansion (Priority Focus):** Embed directly within the Middle East core team to address immediate client demand and support growth strategies in Saudi Arabia.
- **Solution QA & Governance:** Serve as the regional Quality Assurance Director for pre-sales, reviewing and approving solutions ahead of formal governance sign-offs.
- **Commercial Risk & Pricing Strategy:** Drive robust fixed-price structuring, commercial deal mechanics, and risk mitigation across proposals. 
- Methodology & Innovation: Maximize leverage of proprietary assets, frameworks, and AI Works capabilities across all solution designs.

Job qualifications 

Technical Skills 

- multiple years of professional experience, with at least 8+ years in a leadership role at a consultancy.
- Fluent in German (C1) & English

Professional Skills

- Proven success in leading and delivering multi-million pound, multi-year transformation programs.

Fixed price programme delivery experience multiple years

- Expert-level ability to manage project scope and commercial performance, ensuring delivery stays aligned with agreed-upon milestones and business objectives.
- Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a natural ability to translate complex strategic concepts for both technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.
